name: THEHNRI
subtitle: I help businesses grow their presence online — through sharp design, clear strategy, and content that actually connects with people.
about: I'm THEHNRI — a digital creative and founder of Webtellisense, a visibility-first agency based in Eket, Akwa Ibom. I work with businesses that want to be found, remembered, and trusted online. Outside client work, I mentor young designers and build content that brings communities together. Every project I take on is personal.
